text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Topical overdosing of imiquimod cream could result in an increased incidence of severe local skin reactions and may increase the risk for systemic reactions. The most clinically serious adverse reaction reported following multiple oral imiquimod doses of >200 mg (equivalent to imiquimod content of >16 packets of imiquimod cream) was hypotension, which resolved following oral or intravenous fluid administration. Consider contacting the Poison Help line (1-800-222-1222) or a medical toxicologist for additional overdosage management recommendations.
